{{Quote|I don't know what everyone's getting so dramatic about. It's just a simple, holographic piloting exam, after all&hellip;just a game&hellip;not like the real thing.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 100">[[Star Wars (1977) 100|''Star Wars'' (1977) 100]]</ref>}}
'''Holographic piloting exams''' were forms of situational testing administered by the leadership of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] to test a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] flight capabilities and problem-solving skills during combat. The exam included a pre-programmed scenario that was displayed via [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] from the test taker's flight [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. During the [[Nagai–Tof War]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] proctored such an exam, in which [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Fenn Shysa]] and the famed [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] participated alongside many other Alliance pilots. General Solo believed the test beneath him and felt that a pilot proved himself by actually flying, rather than playing what he considered a "game."
